Hi again,

This time I scoured all the Rulebooks and rulings but am still confused.

Pier 13, Port of Baltimore
This equipment card represents a location and does not count as equipment while in play. Unique.
During your influence phase, this minion may equip with a non-location, non-unique equipment card from your hand (requirements and cost apply as normal). This is not an action and cannot be blocked.

I want my renegade garou to have pier 13... now the main rule is it costs 2 blood, allies don't have blood they have life, so he can't pay... other rule says allies that can play cards 'as a vampire' treat life as blood... is disputed territory the only way to get him that pier?

Thanks

Messages.Author: the1andonlime
Messages.Body:
Allies have no blood, so the Garou cannot take the action to equip with the Pier.

Disputed Territory is one way.
I think Reg Driscoll can do it too.
I'm sure that there are other ways of getting the Pier on an ally, but can't think of any at the moment.

Except that you can't use Disputed Territory to change the ownership of loquipment between your minions.

Messages.Author: the1andonlime
Messages.Body:
CRR:

Transferring Locquipment via Disputed Territory to the *same* Methuselah that currently controls the locquipment results in no effect - the locquipment cannot be moved to a different minion of the same Methuselah. [LSJ 19971002]

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
> AaronC wrote:
> Except that you can't use Disputed Territory to change the ownership of loquipment between your minions.
>
> Anybody know where to find the ruling?
>
vekn.net/general-rulings

You'd need two Disputed Territories (one to give it to, say, your prey, and one to take it from your prey).

Nod isn't a valid option, as it doesn't affect locations.
Jack of Both Sides won't work either, as it requires a vampire (and costs a blood).
